audit.why: TRICKY 7/10: even at 1-2 while his W is dodgeable solo, then W-into-E engage plus The Quickness charm outpaces reactive Soraka healing from 3 onward.

audit.whatIsWrong: All 7 level-chart rows disagreed between layers: phases[0,1].side said Rakan while win[0,1] content said Skill, and phases[2-6].side said Skill while win[2-6] content said Rakan.
audit.why: Grand Entrance (W, 11/10/9/8/7s) is dodgeable solo and Rakan has no lockdown until he pairs it with Battle Dance (E, 0s CD, free recast), so levels 1-2 are even; from 3 onward the W-into-E gap-close plus lockdown, then The Quickness (R, 130/110/90s) charm, consistently outpaces Soraka's reactive kit — matches content whys[0-6].
audit.corrected: Realigned all 7 phases[N].side to match win[N] and rewrote the matching why-text and ratings.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two missingInteractions were absent: Gleaming Quill (Q) heals Rakan's allies on champion hit so chip damage needs Grievous Wounds timing, and Battle Dance (E) grants a shield that absorbs your burst window.
audit.why: Both change when you should commit — anti-heal timing and forcing his E shield out first.
audit.corrected: Folded both into report[8] and dosFull[0].d.

edits.before: - Rakan Grand Entrance: matchup-defining — The leap knockup starts every play — track him in fog; the E extends it. The duo’s tempo bends around it. - Keep E Equinox banked for their best play. - The ultimate is a fight decision, not a habit.
edits.after: - Rakan Grand Entrance: 11/10/9/8/7s CD — the leap knockup starts every play, track him in fog; Battle Dance (E, 0s CD) extends it. - His R is 130/110/90s — a fight decision, not a habit. - Your Equinox is 20/19/18/17/16s CD.

edits.before: The leap knockup starts every play — track him in fog; the E extends it. Its cooldown is the green light — wait for it.
edits.after: Battle Dance (E) grants a shield that absorbs your burst window — force it out with poke before you commit, then punish Grand Entrance's cooldown.

edits.before: Q the refill, W the carry, repeat — the battery economy runs while their math wonders why nothing dies.
edits.after: Once Grand Entrance whiffs, his combo is dead until it's back — step up and refill immediately.

edits.before: Healing into a full rotation with the bank empty — Soraka without Q refills is a donation with a horn.
edits.after: Gleaming Quill (Q) heals his allies on champion hit — extended trades without Grievous Wounds just let his sustain out-race yours.

edits.before: World Atlas start. Moonstone, Swiftness, Redemption-Mikael's — heal amps compound the battery. Add anti-heal early into his duo’s sustain.
edits.after: World Atlas start. Moonstone, Swiftness, Redemption-Mikael's — heal amps compound the battery. Add anti-heal early: Gleaming Quill (Q) heals his allies on champion hit, so Grievous Wounds timing decides extended trades.

edits.before: Starcall the contacts — the self-heal funds the bank and the slow annoys their spacing.
edits.after: Level 1 is even — his W is dodgeable and he has no chain CC yet.

edits.before: W opens the battery: your carry's HP bar is now a shared account.
edits.after: Level 2 stays skill-based before he pairs W with his E dash.

edits.before: Equinox threats begin: the silence zone cancels engages mid-cast.
edits.after: Level 3 favors Rakan once W-into-E gives him gap-close plus lockdown.

edits.before: Heal the margins and Q the refills — the battery economy runs the lane.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 favor Rakan as his mobility dodges your poke while he engages.

edits.before: Wish online — every all-in on the map gets a second health bar.
edits.after: The Quickness charm sets up picks your reactive Wish can't prevent.

edits.before: First item: the heals compound and the silence zones decide dives.
edits.after: His CC chain outlasts your heal-per-tick coverage even with first item online.

edits.before: Late Soraka is the global bank: wish the map, silence the dives, and outlast every ledger.
edits.after: Fog flanks and repeated engages keep coming faster than you can heal behind them.
